convert_superglue_checkpoint: convert a SuperGlue PyTorch checkpoint from the original repo to a HuggingFace model
run_superglue_conversion_cli: run the SuperGlue conversion script to convert indoor or outdoor checkpoint to HuggingFace format
verify_superglue_model_outputs: verify converted SuperGlue model outputs match expected keypoints and matching scores
convert_state_dict_keys: convert original SuperGlue state dict keys to HuggingFace SuperGlue key naming convention
add_keypoint_detector_weights: add SuperPoint keypoint detector weights into the SuperGlue state dict for keypoint detection
